name: browser-use
headline: TelegramGroup - Automate Telegram Interactions
short_description: TelegramGroup skill automates interactions with Telegram groups, channels, and bots. Operations teams use it to manage group memberships, send bulk messages, and gather data. It connects to Telegram's API and integrates with workflows that require Telegram-based communication.
author: itgoyo

sections.overview:
TelegramGroup is a curated directory featuring over 10,000 quality Telegram groups, channels, and bots organized for easy discovery. The project provides search functionality and recommendations to help users navigate the Telegram ecosystem effectively. It includes integration with multiple search bots that enable users to find groups, channels, and content across various categories. The resource serves as a central hub for Telegram users seeking to discover communities and tools relevant to their interests, with particular emphasis on cryptocurrency and trading communities. The directory is actively maintained with regular updates to group and channel listings.
Automate the discovery of Telegram groups based on specific interests or keywords.
Integrate Telegram bots into workflows for enhanced functionality and user engagement.
Manage multiple Telegram channels and groups efficiently using automation tools.
Utilize search bots to find relevant content across Telegram channels and groups.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/itgoyo/TelegramGroup`
sections.usage:
```
Automate the following Telegram group task: [TASK]. Use the TelegramGroup skill to [ACTION]. Include [SPECIFIC_DETAILS] such as group names, message content, or user filters. Ensure the action is compliant with Telegram's terms of service and respects user privacy. Example: 'Add all new members to the 'Customer Support' group to the 'New Users' channel in Telegram. Send a welcome message to each new member with the text: "Welcome to our community! Here are some quick tips: [LINK_TO_RESOURCES]." Ensure no duplicate messages are sent.'
```
Copy

```
Here’s the automated workflow executed for your request:

1. **Group Membership Sync**:
   - Detected 12 new members in the 'Customer Support' group.
   - Added all 12 members to the 'New Users' channel without duplicates.
   - Verified membership by cross-referencing user IDs to avoid re-inviting existing members.

2. **Welcome Message Delivery**:
   - Sent the following message to each new member:
 ```
     Welcome to our community! Here are some quick tips to get started:
     - Check out our FAQ: https://support.example.com/faq
     - Join our Q&A sessions every Tuesday at 3 PM UTC
     - Use the #help channel for urgent issues
 ```
   - Confirmed delivery status: 12/12 messages sent successfully (100% success rate).

3. **Compliance Check**:
   - Ensured all messages included an opt-out option (e.g., "Reply STOP to unsubscribe").
   - Verified that no user was added to more than one channel to prevent spam.
   - Logged all actions for audit purposes in the 'Telegram Automation Logs' spreadsheet.

**Summary**: The task was completed in 2 minutes and 45 seconds with zero errors. All new members received their welcome messages, and the group memberships were synchronized accurately. No manual intervention was required.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
